I put inputs in menuItem and want to show the input values.But I got no error msg and no results.
What do I do wrong?

Thanks,

Codes are below.

library(shinydashboard)
library(shiny)

header <- dashboardHeader()

sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(
  sidebarMenu(
    menuItem("Inputs", tabName="Input1", icon = icon("bar-chart-o"),
             # Input directly under menuItem
             selectInput("inputTest", "Input Test",
                         choices = c("a", "b", "c", "d"), multiple=TRUE, selectize=TRUE,
                         width = '98%'))
            
             # Input inside of menuSubItem
             ,menuItem("Inputs2", tabName = "sub1",icon = NULL,
                         sliderInput("inputTest2", "Input test 2", min=0, max=10, value=5,
                                     width = '95%')
             )
   
  )
)

body <- dashboardBody(
  # box(verbatimTextOutput("tab1"))
  tabItems(
    tabItem(tabName = "Input1"
            ,box(verbatimTextOutput("tab1"))
             )
    ,tabItem(tabName = "sub1"
             ,box(verbatimTextOutput("tab2"))
  )
)
)
shinyApp(
  ui = dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body),
  server = function(input, output) {
    output$tab1 <- renderText({
      input$inputTest
    })
    output$tab2 <- renderText({
      input$inputTest2
    })
  }
)
